subject: SOC2 supplemental evidence - MFA / key management sampling plan
messages:
From: Erin Spencer <erin.spencer@veriteaudit.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: sam.jenkins@clearpoint.com
Date: 2027-04-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Supplemental evidence request - MFA enforcement + key rotation

Hi Markus,

Thanks for sharing the SOC 2 Type II report earlier. As part of our scoped review for ClearPoint (SOC 2 reliance), we need a few supplemental artifacts to close the authentication and key-management controls: 

- MFA enforcement evidence: enforcement policy and a short slice (CSV) of authentication logs showing successful 2FA/elevated-auth events for the audit period (2023-10-01 to 2024-09-30).
- Key management proof: rotation records or change logs for the KEK/KMS that show rotation events during the period and the current key custodian process diagram.
- Access review evidence: the latest quarterly privileged access review and remediation spreadsheet.

Can you confirm feasibility and proposed delivery dates? If you can’t provide raw logs, a redacted CSV with user IDs hashed and timestamps will work. We’ll need proofs by 2027-04-10 to stay on our timeline.

Appreciate it — Erin
Erin Spencer, Senior SOC Auditor
Verite Audit LLC

-----
Attachment: request_checklist.pdf (stub)

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Erin Spencer <erin.spencer@veriteaudit.com>, Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@clearpoint.com>
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-03T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Supplemental evidence request - MFA enforcement + key rotation

Erin — thanks for the clear list. We can provide all three items, with one ask on scope below.

Plan (high level):
- MFA: we’ll provide the policy PDF plus a redacted log slice covering the requested audit period. We will pseudonymize user identifiers and include the MFA method and timestamp columns.
- KEK/KMS rotation: Priyom will pull KMS rotation events and the key custodian diagram (current ops runbook).
- Access review: Laura will export the Q4 2023 privileged access review and remediation tracker.

Scope question: are you expecting raw session debug logs for SSO/OIDC or just the auth events (login/2FA/refresh)? We prefer to provide auth event slices only. If you need full session traces we’ll need a short justification (and likely redaction).

Delivery timeline suggestion: initial package by 2027-04-08, final redacted logs by 2027-04-10. We can use the DocuSign link for a quick mutual NDA amendment if ClearPoint needs extra confidentiality for raw traces.

Assigning owners: Mina (evidence collation), Priyom (KMS artifacts), Laura (access review export).

—Markus
Markus Klein | Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

From: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
To: Erin Spencer <erin.spencer@veriteaudit.com>, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@clearpoint.com>
Date: 2027-04-03T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Supplemental evidence request - MFA enforcement + key rotation

Thanks — quick status update from Compliance/Platform: 

- MFA policy: attached (mfa_authentication_policy.pdf). This covers enforcement for both SSO (IdP) and native fallback.
- Auth-log slice: we can produce an aggregated CSV with columns [event_id, user_hash, event_type, method, timestamp, device_type]. We will exclude IP addresses and session tokens. I’ve attached a sample extract (log_slice_mfa_202311.csv) for November 2023 to confirm format.
- KMS/KEK rotation: Priyom will attach the rotation audit log and a hand-drawn ops diagram (kek-rotation-diagram.png) showing custodians and rotation cadence. Rotation events are recorded in our KMS and signed by the rotation owner; we can provide signed rotation timestamps as CSV.
- Access review: attached export (access_review_report_Q4_2023.csv) with reviewer, review_date, findings, and remediation status.

We’ll redact personal identifiers per the NDA and mask emails to hashed IDs. If you need deterministic hashes (for tracing across files) call it out and we’ll provide the hashing salt via an encrypted channel.

ETA: initial bundle (PDFs + sample CSV) uploaded to the secure drive link by EOD 2027-04-03. Full audit slices for the full period targeted for 2027-04-08.

Mina Haddad
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
Attachments: mfa_authentication_policy.pdf; log_slice_mfa_202311.csv; access_review_report_Q4_2023.csv

From: Erin Spencer <erin.spencer@veriteaudit.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@clearpoint.com>
Date: 2027-04-03T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Supplemental evidence request - MFA enforcement + key rotation

Thanks Mina — that sample extract looks fine. Two clarifications before we close scope: 

1) For the auth events, we’ll need at least one example of a successful MFA fallback (native OTP) during the period — include event_type="mfa_fallback" in the slice if available.
2) For KMS rotation, can you include the signing principal (redacted) and a rotation event ID so we can tie the rotation claim back to the entry in the rotation ledger? A CSV with rotation_id, timestamp, rotation_owner_hash, and rotation_note will work.

If those two items are deliverable by 2027-04-08 we’ll mark this as on-track. Otherwise flag which item slips and why.

—Erin

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: Erin Spencer <erin.spencer@veriteaudit.com>, mina_haddad@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@clearpoint.com>
Date: 2027-04-04T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Supplemental evidence request - MFA enforcement + key rotation

Erin — quick follow-up from the platform team. We can provide the rotation ledger CSV with the fields you requested: rotation_id, timestamp_utc, rotation_owner_hash, rotation_note, rotation_signature_id. The rotation_signature_id references a signed envelope in our HSM audit store — we’ll include a pointer (secure drive link) to the signed envelope for verification.

On the MFA_fallback event: our auth pipeline emits event_type="mfa_fallback" for native OTP. I attached a small proof extract showing that event type for two users (Nov 15 & Dec 08, 2023). If you need a larger sample for correlation, let us know the minimum sample size.

We will put the full CSVs on the secure drive and share the drive link and the DocuSign NDA amendment if ClearPoint requires the extra confidentiality layer.

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das
Security Engineer, Platform | Redwood Inference
Attachments: kek-rotation-diagram.png; redwood_soc2_type2_2023.pdf
